gloss: monthly tuition fee; monthly lesson fee

definitions.gloss: monthly tuition fee; monthly lesson fee
definitions.explanation: A fixed fee paid each month for lessons, classes, or instruction. Commonly used for private lessons, cram schools, martial arts dojos, and similar learning settings.

examples.japanese: ピアノの{月謝|げっしゃ}は{一万円|いちまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The monthly fee for piano lessons is ten thousand yen.

examples.japanese: {月謝|げっしゃ}を{払|はら}い{忘|わす}れていた。
examples.english: I forgot to pay the monthly tuition.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{習|なら}い{事|ごと}の{月謝|げっしゃ}が{家計|かけい}を{圧迫|あっぱく}している。
examples.english: The monthly fees for our children's lessons are straining the household budget.

notes:
USAGE:
{月謝|げっしゃ} specifically refers to fees paid monthly for ongoing instruction. It is not used for one-time payments or university tuition ({学費|がくひ} or {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月謝|げっしゃ}を{払|はら}う (to pay the monthly fee)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}を{納|おさ}める (to submit the monthly fee — more formal)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}が{高|たか}い (the monthly fee is expensive)
- {月謝|げっしゃ}{袋|ぶくろ} (envelope for monthly fees)

FORMS:
{月|げつ} (month) + {謝|しゃ} (gratitude/remuneration). The {謝|しゃ} carries the sense of payment in appreciation for instruction.
